title: Microsoft Entra ID: extended 30-day backup and recovery through Microsoft 365 Backup
summary: Hold: the controls incorrectly describe the Entra backup and recovery experience as excluding Premium, although Microsoft documents that experience for both plans. The service-principal recovery description also omits which permission grants and app role assignments are restored. The roadmap facts, Premium default, licensing and price are supported.
